items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not mention Harlan Leonard. The interviewer mentions Harlan Leonard in the context of Thamon Hayes ('He was with Harlan Leonard after he took the Rockets'). The interviewee responds about Thamon Hayes, not Harlan Leonard.

ctx.x: fighting each other or something -- you know, disagreeing -- in the Bennie Moten band. So they...they split. Half of them went one way, and half went the other. The one that went...that wasn't...that didn't stay with Bennie was Thamon Hayes. He took the band, Thamon Hayes. And we stayed together for a little while. This band later turned out to be the Rockets, the Kansas City Rockets.
Yes. Harlan was in the band, but he wasn't in...he didn't have...it wasn't his band at first.
